title: Thorough preparations to ensure orderly elections and social stability
text:
At the Cabinet's weekly meeting Thursday, Premier Cho Jung-tai was briefed by the Central Election Commission (CEC), the Ministry of Transportation and Communications and the Ministry of the Interior (MOI) on preparations for the upcoming 2026 local elections and national referendum, scheduled for November 28. The premier directed all relevant ministries and agencies to ensure the thorough implementation of election administration, transportation arrangements and security measures.

Premier Cho called on the CEC to carefully review all aspects of election operations, step up public information efforts, ensure effective oversight of election commissions across all special municipalities, counties and cities, and formulate plans for various contingencies. He also encouraged strong voter participation, expressing hope that the elections and referendum will be successfully conducted in accordance with the principles of fairness, impartiality, transparency and administrative neutrality.

Regarding election security, the premier cautioned that external forces may seek to interfere with the elections through various means. He instructed the CEC to enhance election planning and contingency measures, while directing the MOI and other related ministries and agencies to strengthen coordination and communication, guard against external interference involving funding, deepfake content, disinformation and other tactics, and respond effectively to any illegal activities or public disturbances on election day.
